summary_1line: Kadru and Vinata journey to view the celestial horse, passing the vast, terrifying, mythic ocean described in grand cosmological detail.

image_candidates.scene_text: The immense ocean roars with towering waves and whirlpools while monstrous sea creatures churn beneath the dark waters.
Thousands of mighty rivers rush proudly into the boundless ocean like eager rivals racing to meet it.
The ocean’s surging waves rise like uplifted arms as winds lash the waters and foam under a vast sky.
